verdict.rationale: Sift exposes REST APIs that let an agent read risk posture: the Score API returns 0-100 risk scores, and the Decisions API records actions such as blocking or banning users. A Workflows API and Review Queues exist alongside the console-based Workflows rules platform. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent creating or editing rules (such as a velocity rule) or managing blocklists programmatically. The Review Queues are for human review of flagged users, not for approving agent-proposed configuration changes. missing for 10: documented API for creating and updating rules or workflows, programmatic list/blocklist management, human approval gates on agent-initiated changes, agent/MCP tooling, hands-on corroboration.
